title: What is a model version change?
summary: Sometimes a model identifier stays similar, but the provider updates the underlying model or its behavior. This can change: - Response style. - Reasoning behavior. - Tool calling. - Structured output. - Latency. - Token consumption. - Accuracy. - Safety behavior.
